facts.value: The receiving institution/enterprise must be either a university awarded with an Erasmus Charter for Higher Education or any public or private organization.

A small, medium or large enterprise (including social enterprises), a public body at local, regional or national level, a social partner or other representative of working life, including chambers of commerce, craft/professional associations and trade unions, a research institute, a foundation, a school/institute/educational center, a non-profit organization, association or NGO, or a body providing career guidance, professional counseling, and information services.
